attributes.board_name: Colorado Division of Professions and Occupations (DORA) – Office of Speech-Language Pathology Certification / Office of Audiology Licensure

rules.accepted_credit_types: Continuing Professional Development program: Reflective Self-Assessment, Learning Plan and 10 Professional Development Activities (1 PDA = 1 clock hour) from at least two categories (max 5 per category) – volunteer service, mentoring/supervision, presentations (2 PDA per hour, first delivery), coursework, independent learning, group study – or all 10 via coursework. Alternatives: Deemed Status through the Colorado Department of Education (ASHA is NOT an approved deemed-status entity) or military exemption.
rules.new_licensee_rule: CPC requirements start after the first renewal of the initial certificate.
rules.audit_note: Compliance audits after each certification period; keep documentation at least 5 years.
rules.notes: Colorado certifies (not licenses) SLPs. One-year certification period; current certificates expire 11/30/2026 with renewal possible through 1/31/2027. PDA must be directly relevant to SLP competence and generally cannot be duties of the primary job.

rules.accepted_credit_types: CE in subjects related to the audiologist's scope of practice; no limit on online hours.
rules.new_licensee_rule: CE requirements begin immediately upon licensure.
rules.audit_note: Compliance audits after each license period; keep CE records at least 4 years; submit only if requested.
rules.legal_basis: Colorado Audiology rules (DPO – Audiology and Hearing Aid Provider Licensure)
rules.notes: At least 10 hours during each two-year license period.
